assessment_objectives.objective: a backup architecture is documented that identifies backup storage locations, data flows and the mechanisms used to protect backup copies.
backup copies are stored in an immutable form (e.g., Write Once Read Many (WORM) storage, object lock or retention lock) that prevents modification or deletion for the defined immutability period.
the period for which backup copies remain immutable is defined.
backup copies and backup infrastructure are protected from unauthorized access, including through encryption of backup data and access restrictions on backup repositories.

privileged actions on the backup infrastructure (e.g., deleting backups or changing retention or immutability settings) are restricted to authorized personnel, require multi-factor authentication and are logged.
the immutability of backup copies is tested at a defined frequency and the results are documented.
